propositions: Authors and agents lack an enforceable mechanism to hold changes with known review defects; ticket comments and session logs are advisory and invisible to submitters who follow the submission rule.
Gerrit WIP state is the only hold that blocks submission for all submitters regardless of role, but none of the contribution docs mention it as the hold mechanism for known issues.

The documented contribution flow must require marking changes with unresolved findings as WIP at push time (%wip) or after submission (POST endpoint), and require unmarking (%ready / /ready) once resolved.
Documentation must be reachable through three surfaces: CONTRIBUTING.md (authoritative), the packaged code-review guide surfaced by rebar explain review, and AGENTS.md.
The rule must be tested by asserting its presence through the packaged registry mapping, not the file path, to catch if the guide stops being packaged.
